recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not revert dispenserInstruction to Annotation under FHIR-28601; any future datatype reconsideration should be handled through the FHIR-52891 change family or a new Pharmacy work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-28601 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised for R4 MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest. It asked for a way for an orderer to provide comments to the pharmacist, with resolution text to add MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction at 0..* and datatype Annotation.
initial_application: Commit aa9bb900cb46fbcac2b5689dcf3a735a3524f12c, titled 'FHIR-28601, FHIR-27885, FHIR-27834', added MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction as a 0..* Annotation row to the MedicationRequest spreadsheet. The later source rework introduced the current StructureDefinition source, which still contains the element.
additional_context: The current fhir.ini actively lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest and tracks MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction in change annotations. FHIR-52891, a later Applied/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue, intentionally changed the element from Annotation to CodeableConcept and added an example terminology binding; the combined branch already contains an audit commit for FHIR-52891.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition already has MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction with min 0, max *, and a definition for additional information to the dispenser. The only apparent mismatch from the 2020 FHIR-28601 resolution, the datatype, is due to the later final FHIR-52891 decision.
